The '''Kingdom of Seraphina''' was an absolute monarchy listed among the defunct nations of the Avant world.

The source table gives its formation as 1642 and its dissolution as 1933. No dedicated Seraphina article has been found in the current checkout, so this draft preserves only the list-backed state name, government type, and dates.

== Canon Limits ==

Do not assign Seraphina a continent, capital, dynasty, war role, successor state, or territorial outcome until stronger source material is reviewed.
